verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents a public v3 Web API, a REST interface with endpoints such as POST /v3/mail/send and regional base URLs. Official getting-started guides cover cURL and the official SDKs, and machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md docs) are also served. missing for 10: documented API coverage beyond Mail Send (e.g. account, template and settings management) shown in the pack, independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The SendGrid v3 Web API provides a REST interface to send email at scale and ensure your application can handle high volumes.
The Mail Send operation allows you to send email over SendGrid's v3 Web API
You can send your first email with the SendGrid API using cURL or one of the official SendGrid libraries.
Base url: https://api.eu.sendgrid.com (for EU regional subusers)
